title: What Matters, When? Diagnosing and Improving Conditional Visual Grounding in Visuomotor Imitation Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.05376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visuomotor imitation policies can achieve high performance under in-distribution visual conditions yet fail when visually similar objects or receptacles are introduced. We study this behavior as a problem of conditional visual grounding: the visual target required for successful control changes with the manipulation phase and, in more complex tasks, with the observed task state. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), we systematically introduce distractor objects and receptacles with controlled color and shape similarity and localize failures to picking and placement. We find that distractor sensitivity is specific to both the type of visual similarity and the manipulation stage. translated_title: 何为关键，何时关键？视觉运动模仿策略中条件视觉定位的诊断与改进
translated_abstract: 视觉运动模仿策略在分布内的视觉条件下可以达到很高的性能，但在引入视觉相似的物体或容器时就会失效。我们将这种行为视为一个条件视觉定位问题：成功控制所需的视觉目标会随操作阶段而变化，在更复杂的任务中还会随观察到的任务状态而变化。使用基于Transformer的动作分块方法（ACT），我们系统地引入了具有可控颜色和形状相似度的干扰物体和干扰容器，并将失败定位在抓取和放置阶段。我们发现干扰物敏感性同时取决于视觉相似性的类型和操作阶段。基于这一诊断，我们评估了干扰物增强、阶段相关的注意力正则化以及基于外观的视觉提示作为互补干预措施，用于在保留控制所需空间信息的同时改进目标选择。
tldr: 该论文诊断出视觉运动模仿策略对干扰物的敏感性取决于视觉相似性类型与操作阶段的组合，并提出干扰物增强、阶段相关注意力正则化和基于外观的视觉提示三种互补干预方法，系统性地改进了随操作阶段动态变化的条件视觉定位能力。
en_tdlr: This paper diagnoses that distractor sensitivity in visuomotor imitation policies depends on both the type of visual similarity and the manipulation stage, and proposes complementary interventions—distractor augmentation, phase-dependent attention regularization, and appearance-based visual prompting—to improve conditional visual grounding.
